_comment: Vlog-style English voice-over for Videos/pinlog_demo_concat.mp4 (30.1 s). `at` = seconds from the start. [bracket] tags are ElevenLabs v3 audio tags; they are stripped for captions and for non-v3 models. `caption` overrides the on-screen subtitle text (defaults to the spoken line without tags). `labels` are hand-written location tags shown top-left; `cards` are centred title text.

cues.scene: Cathedral of Learning dissolves into a watercolor notebook page
cues.text: Okay so, I take too many photos. Pinlog turns them into a story.

cues.scene: Phipps glasshouse inside and out, then the Warhol gallery
cues.text: My Pittsburgh day: the Cathedral, Phipps, and an afternoon with Warhol.

cues.scene: Gallery photo painted over into a journal page with a camera and lavender
cues.text: And it paints it all into a little hand-drawn journal, pinned on my map.

cues.scene: CMU campus from above, then Spring Carnival: Ferris wheel, booths, a student drawing on a red wall
cues.text: [excited] Then Carnival on campus! Ferris wheel, the booths, and yeah, I doodled on the wall.

cues.scene: Kennywood wooden coaster under storm clouds
cues.text: Then Kennywood, storm rolling in. [laughs] Iconic.

cues.scene: Finished journal closed on a wooden table
